arguments.prompt: Use case: identity-preserve. Asset type: production RGBA battle animation source, NOT a promotional illustration. Input 1 is the canonical face, fitted armor, adult body proportions and material rendering. Input 2 is the accepted standing-body scale and costume reference only. Create FOUR genuinely different consecutive full-body drawings in a strict equal 2x2 grid, preferably 2048 square, transparent background. Natural 8-head adult proportions, small mature narrow grey-green eyes, stern long almond eye shape, defined straight nose and jaw, cool intimidating expression matching Input 1 exactly. No cute face, no round childlike eyes, no enlarged head, no smile. Face, hands, armor and cape share the same refined 2D animation/painterly rendering. Preserve silver flowing hair, every white-silver armor plate and gold thorn trim, black joint undersuit, slim long legs, long ivory cape with black lining and gold embroidery. Hair is flowing fine natural strands not plastic spikes. The four figures must stay LARGE and consistent anatomical scale, fully inside each quadrant with generous transparent gutters; do not crop cape or feet. Each holds ONLY the exact short black/gold grip stub in his right armored hand: NO GUARD, NO BLADE, NO EXTRA WEAPONS. The approved blade/guard will be rigid-composited later. Five anatomically correct fingers gripping naturally, connected wrists, no extra fingers. Same camera: full-body 3/4 facing RIGHT, eye-level battle sprite, minimal perspective, no zoom or foreshortening changes. Redraw the ENTIRE connected head/neck/body for every pose, do not paste faces. No ground disc, labels, text, particles, aura, shadows on background, or frame borders. Sequence A, frames 1-4 of a dominating HEAVY WAIST-DRIVEN SWORD CUT by the strongest human swordsman. It must feel powerful and controlled, not a timid fencing thrust. Top-left: poised planted stance, right hand low beside hip holding the short stub, shoulders square and calm, left hand relaxed. Top-right: rear foot compresses, lead foot makes a short committed step, torso coils back, right elbow BENT and right hand rises beside shoulder holding stub nearly vertical for a high guard; cape lags behind. Bottom-left: hip uncoils into the cut, right upper arm drives forward, right elbow still slightly bent, hand travels diagonally down toward chest height; left arm balances behind, face fixed intensely on target. Bottom-right: decisive CHEST-HEIGHT horizontal cutting contact, torso rotated through, right shoulder drives the cut with elbow slightly bent (NOT straight out in a fencing point), compact strong grip stub almost horizontal pointing toward right, wide stable but not exaggerated legs, front knee loaded, rear heel pivots, torso upright and tall. Left hand pulled back for counterbalance. Cape explodes backward in a broad layered sweep. Keep all four heads the exact SAME MAN as canonical artwork.
